SUMMARY: CeilingLightFactory builds a single ceiling-mounted light fixture: a black metal reflector trough/dome (curve-lofted circle + extruded shell + ngon backing) with a white emissive-style inner bulb/diffuser, plus a parented point light source. The upper-level file samples fixture geometry parameters, assigns black/white materials with optional wear/scratch overlays, drives a Geometry Nodes group that builds the mesh, and attaches a PointLampFactory light offset below the fixture.

EDITABLE (upper-level files — change these to alter the result):
FILE: assets/objects/lamp/ceiling_lights.py
  CeilingLightFactory.__init__: sets up geometry params, point light, materials, beveler.
    knobs: dimensions([1,1,1], fixed passed in) -> unused scale hint; ceiling_light_default_params(3 preset dicts of Radius/Thickness/InnerRadius/Height/InnerHeight/Curvature) -> alternative fixed geometry presets (only used if use_default=True); beveler mult(U(1,3), random) -> sharpness/strength of edge bevel
  CeilingLightFactory.sample_parameters: randomly samples fixture geometry (default path).
    knobs: Radius(clip_gaussian(0.12,0.04,0.1,0.25)) -> outer reflector radius; Thickness(U(0.005,0.05)) -> shell wall thickness; InnerRadius(Radius*U(0.4,0.9)) -> bulb/diffuser radius; Height(0.7*clip_gaussian(0.09,0.03,0.07,0.15)) -> trough depth; InnerHeight(Height*U(0.5,1.1)) -> inner bulb vertical extent; Curvature(U(0.1,0.5)) -> flattening/curve of inner dome; use_default(False) -> switch to preset dicts
  CeilingLightFactory.get_material_params: assigns materials and wear.
    knobs: black_material(shader_black, fixed) -> reflector/frame color; white_material(shader_lamp_bulb_nonemissive, fixed) -> tube/diffuser look; scratch/edge_wear (probabilistic via material_assignments.wear_tear_prob/wear_tear) -> surface aging overlays
  CeilingLightFactory.create_asset: copies mesh, bevels, spawns & parents point light.
    knobs: lamp loc/rot((0,0,0), fixed); lamp.location.z -= 0.03 (fixed) -> light offset below fixture
  CeilingLightFactory.finalize_assets: applies scratch/edge_wear if sampled.
  nodegroup_ceiling_light_geometry: Geometry Nodes graph building the fixture mesh.
    knobs: CurveCircle Resolution(512, fixed) -> smoothness of reflector ring; IcoSphere Subdivisions(5, fixed) -> inner dome tessellation; less_than Z threshold(0.0010) -> cutoff separating lower dome hemisphere; SetShadeSmooth(False, fixed) -> flat shading; combine_xyz_3 Z=Curvature -> inner dome vertical scale; Fill Caps(True) inner tube -> closed bulb ends; LightPosition vector((0,0,0), fixed) -> reported light anchor

LINKED TO INFINIGEN (infra — do NOT edit, resolved from the original package):
  assets/lighting/indoor_lights.py -> PointLampFactory: emissive point light source spawned & parented to fixture
  assets/materials/lamp_shaders.py -> shader_black & shader_lamp_bulb_nonemissive material shaders
  assets/composition/material_assignments.py -> wear_tear / wear_tear_prob probabilistic aging material selection
  assets/materials/wear_tear/scratches.py -> scratch surface overlay material
  assets/materials/wear_tear/edge_wear.py -> edge-wear surface overlay material
  assets/utils/autobevel.py -> BevelSharp: automatic sharp-edge beveling operator
  assets/utils/object.py -> mesh/object spawn & copy helpers
  core/nodes/node_wrangler.py, node_utils.py, node_info.py -> Geometry Nodes construction API (Nodes, NodeWrangler, to_nodegroup)
  core/surface.py -> shaderfunc_to_material conversion
  core/placement/factory.py -> AssetFactory base (placeholder/asset lifecycle)
  core/placement/detail.py -> level-of-detail management
  core/util/blender.py -> spawn_cube, copy, modify_mesh, parent_to helpers
  core/util/math.py -> FixedSeed, clip_gaussian sampling utilities
  core/util/random.py, color.py -> random/color sampling utilities
  assets/materials/* (metal, plastic, wood, ceramic, fabric, etc.) -> material library registry referenced via material_assignments
  core/tags.py, core/nodes/compatibility.py, utils.py -> tagging & Blender-version node compatibility support
